name: iTech Minerals Ltd
summary: iTech Minerals Limited and its subsidiaries explore across Australia for industrial and battery-grade minerals, including halloysite-kaolinite, graphite, gold and base metals. Its gold-focused tenure covers prospects in the Gawler Craton, such as Billa Kalina and the Eyre Peninsula Gold Project, and the Nackara Arc Copper-Gold project in the Delamerian Orogen.
